shots.title: Document the Sprint ID 2.0 migration and recovery path
shots.notes: Added backup, upgrade, compatibility, verification, and restore guidance for SQLite and PostgreSQL operators.

shots.title: Add a read-only sprint migration doctor
shots.notes: Added SQLite and PostgreSQL metadata inspection with human and JSON output, malformed-store handling, and proof that legacy stores remain unchanged.

shots.title: Validate the 2.0.0 release candidate
shots.notes: Typecheck, build, package dry-run, docs, map, roadmap, and 4,447 tests passed. Durable schema-migration evidence raises the release recommendation from the conventional minor tier to major.

conditions.description: The release changes persisted sprint identity and therefore requires an operator-visible backup and recovery path.

training.description: Release-tier heuristics cannot infer every breaking operational contract from commit prefixes.
training.outcome: The checked-in release policy and issue contract override the minor heuristic and require 2.0.0 for the store migration.

nutrition.description: Full suite: 264 test files passed, 2 skipped; 4,447 tests passed, 34 skipped. The 33 PostgreSQL integration tests remain delegated to CI when SLOPE_TEST_PG_URL is available.
Typecheck, production build, docs check, map check, roadmap source/projection validation, diff check, and npm package dry-run passed.

bunker_locations: Treat a required store schema migration as a major release even when conventional commit analysis recommends a minor.
A migration doctor must inspect metadata without constructing the normal store because normal store construction applies migrations.
Release documentation must distinguish automatic upgrade from restore-based downgrade; 1.x writers cannot safely coexist after migration.
yardage_book_updates: Run slope store migrate doctor before any ordinary 2.0 command when upgrading an existing project.
Verify a backup and stop all 1.x writers before opening the store with 2.0.
Use backend-specific schema targets when reporting migration status.
course_management_notes: Merge S267 before the version-only PR so the 2.0.0 package contains the migration guide and doctor.
After the version PR and main CI pass, create GitHub release v2.0.0 to trigger trusted npm publishing, then verify both artifacts and close #659.
